assumptions: Format and rule checks run on the folder path with a trailing '/', so a folder named adam/sdtm/raw as the last folder still matches /adam/, /sdtm/ or raw/.
Pattern checks such as /med, /cdap, /idap, /anon are plain substring matches on the folder path, case-sensitive unless stated.
For anonymised folders the underscore format is searched in the folder path (any folder), not only the last folder.
Skipped files (markers, files with no study folder, no extension) are neither moved nor listed in the report.
Study ID is the first folder under incoming/; the study itself is not validated.
The data_reuse + cdar example is an error because both CDAR and OTHERS match (two rules).
The cron */45 fires at minutes 0 and 45 of each hour, so the gap is 45 then 15 minutes; this is taken as intended.
The bucket name is set per environment; the region eu-north-1 comes from the document.
